proc.titleDwgMissing: DWG support is not installed yet
proc.lostHeadline: That analysis is no longer running.
proc.lostBody: The server process restarted while the drawing was being read. On a small instance this usually means the drawing needed more memory than the instance has.
proc.lostFix: Upload the drawing again, or use an instance with more memory.

viewer.pickHint: Click two points on a known dimension
status.meaningGeometricSub: A measurement of the linework only
status.meaningProvisionalSub: What this region represents is unconfirmed
status.confidenceAfterCalibration: Available once a scale is established
cta.calibrateHint: No physical area can be reported until the drawing is calibrated against a known distance.
cta.stateUnitsHint: This CAD drawing does not declare its units. State them to obtain a physical area.
cal.step1: Click the first point of a known dimension
cal.step3: Enter the real distance and apply
cal.drawnOnDrawing: The span you measured is drawn on the drawing in red. Check it is the line you intended.
cal.notVerified: This scale was supplied by you, not verified from the drawing.
cal.noScaleDetail: No scale could be established from the drawing.
cadUnit.title: Units not declared
cadUnit.explain: This drawing leaves $INSUNITS at 0, so it does not say which unit its coordinates are in. Its own dimensions measure:
cadUnit.extent: Extent {w} × {h} drawing units. One drawing unit is:
cadUnit.note: The geometry is the drawing's own; only the unit is yours, so the result is labelled operator-stated.
warn.noScale: No verified scale, so no physical area is reported for this drawing.
warn.noScaleWhy: Physical area is withheld rather than estimated, because an unverified scale would make every number wrong by an unknown factor.
warn.operatorScale: Scale was operator calibrated, not derived from the drawing.
warn.operatorScaleWhy: The scale was supplied by a person, not derived from the drawing, so the area inherits that judgement.
warn.noPdfText: No embedded PDF text was found; dimension annotation is stroked geometry.
warn.noPdfTextWhy: Without text there are no dimensions to calibrate from, so the scale must be supplied by hand.
warn.strokedAnnotation: Stroked annotation geometry may inflate the envelope and bounding rectangle.
warn.strokedAnnotationWhy: Annotation counted as geometry enlarges envelopes and bounding rectangles.
warn.provisionalMeaningWhy: This is a geometric construction. What it represents has not been established, so do not quote it as a named physical region.
explain.scaleNotVerified: Not verified — no physical area is reported
explain.resultUnavailable: Not available without a verified scale
layers.title: CAD Layers
layers.noneForPdf: CAD layers are available when a DWG or DXF is loaded. A printed PDF carries no layer information — that is the main reason the CAD file is the better source.
layers.verbatim: Layer names are shown exactly as the file records them. No business meaning is assigned to them.
dwg.notInstalledBody: DWG files are converted locally — nothing is uploaded anywhere — but the conversion component is not present yet.
dwg.deployImage: This deployment does not include the DWG conversion component. Upload a DXF or PDF export instead.
msg.scale.notEstablished: No scale could be established from the drawing. Calibrate against a known distance.
msg.scale.noPhysicalArea: Scale not verified, so no physical projected area is reported.
msg.scale.operatorSupplied: The scale was supplied by the operator.
msg.scale.printedRatioAssumed: The printed drawing ratio was assumed; a fit-to-page print would invalidate it.
msg.geometry.noneReconstructed: No valid closed profile could be reconstructed from the linework.
msg.region.wholePage: The whole page was measured rather than a selected view.
recent.heading: Recent analyses
recent.empty: No saved analyses yet. A completed analysis is kept so you can reopen it without measuring again.
ws.saveDisabled: Not saved — this instance keeps no history
cache.title: This drawing has already been measured
cache.body: An analysis of this exact file by this exact engine version was completed on {when}. Reopening it restores the result without measuring again.
